answer: Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The defence rests on hunting licence tenure with wildlife authority records: a licence held continuously with one wildlife authority. Forging 481 of these means building 481 separate licence tenures from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the relic signal is public, the plume check is automatic, and 481 aliases cost 481 times what one real agent costs, with the lantern trail open to all.
